QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] Enki's Identity
QuestInfo.0: The ancient god of Identisk Island quietly gives away blessings in secret.
QuestInfo.1: The ancient god of Identisk Island quietly gives away blessings in secret. Now that you know their identity, go visit the ancient god of Identisk Island.
QuestInfo.2: The ancient god Enki asked that you keep his existence a secret and saids he will leave for the safety of the island. Maybe you'll meet again one day...
